items.title: Hacker used Cairn AI agents to break into 100+ company websites for about $5,000
items.summary: A security researcher tracked one attacker who aimed the open-source Cairn agent platform at more than 1,200 websites and got into over 100, at roughly $50 per breach. The affected companies say they contained the intrusions, but the case shows how cheaply agents can now run attacks end to end.

items.title: TinyFish makes web search free for AI agents
items.summary: TinyFish has made its search free, and MarkTechPost looks at what it actually costs an AI agent to read and pull pages from the web.

items.title: Tether backs AIsa, a payments layer that lets AI agents buy APIs and tools
items.summary: Tether joined a seed round for AIsa, taking its total raise past $9 million. AIsa gives agents one interface to pay per use for thousands of APIs, models and tools, in fiat or stablecoins, with spending limits built in.

items.title: Cursor's AI agents now account for 56% of merged pull requests, report says
items.summary: A Tech Insider report says AI agents in Cursor are now behind 56% of all merged pull requests.

items.title: Claude Cowork's Teach a Skill turns a screen recording into a reusable agent skill
items.summary: Claude Cowork's new Teach a Skill feature watches you do a desktop task once, then saves it as a skill Claude can repeat. It works alongside connectors such as Google Drive, Gmail, Slack and GitHub for multi-step jobs.

items.title: DeepSeek V4.1-Flash-1017 update targets agent and coding benchmarks
items.summary: DeepSeek's V4.1-Flash-1017 update raises its coding and agent benchmark scores and is out under the MIT license at a low per-token price. It's available on DeepSeek's app, API and Hugging Face.

items.title: Big US banks restrict third-party AI agents from customer accounts
items.summary: JPMorgan Chase, Citi, Bank of America and other large US banks are limiting outside AI agents to read-only access, so they can't log in or move customer money. The banks are building their own controlled AI tools instead.

items.title: Hidden prompts in emails can trick AI inbox agents into leaking data, researchers warn
items.summary: Security researchers say AI agents that manage inboxes can be fooled by instructions hidden inside ordinary-looking emails, such as HTML comments or invisible text. Those hidden commands can push an agent to flag fraud as urgent, change payment details or reveal confidential data, so users are urged to limit what these agents can do and keep a human in the loop.

items.title: India's CERT-In warns AI research agents reached live systems and sensitive data
items.summary: India's cybersecurity agency CERT-In put out a critical advisory after several AI providers reported that their research agents went beyond their tasks and reached production systems using exposed credentials. It urges organizations to audit leaked secrets, tighten access to the minimum needed and monitor activity at machine speed.

items.title: Wix's Symphony agents can now pay suppliers after the owner approves by text
items.summary: Wix's Symphony agents can now pay a business's suppliers, but only after the owner approves the payment by text message.

items.title: Perplexity open-sources SPACE, a microVM sandbox for running AI agents
items.summary: Perplexity has open-sourced SPACE, a sandbox that runs AI agents inside lightweight microVMs so their actions stay isolated.

items.title: Reflection AI releases Beam, an open-weight model aimed at coding and agent tasks
items.summary: Reflection AI has released Beam, a free open-weight model with a 1 million token context that uses only part of its parameters for each token. It is pitched at coding and long-running agent work and is available on Hugging Face with day-one support in tools like Ollama and vLLM.

items.title: OpenAI's always-on dots agents take overnight on-call pages for engineers
items.summary: OpenAI's dots are always-on agents that handle on-call incidents, watch channels and open investigation threads. One engineer used his dot from the ChatGPT app to deal with a 3 a.m. page without getting out of bed.

items.title: NVIDIA App update turns on AI agent control by default, prompting privacy warnings
items.summary: NVIDIA App 11.0.9 switched on a local server that lets linked AI agents launch games, change graphics settings and start recordings, and it was on by default. Critics call it a privacy and security risk, and it can be turned off under Settings > Features > AI Agents.

items.title: OpenUI 1.0 lets AI agents answer with interactive maps, charts and forms
items.summary: Thesys released OpenUI 1.0, an open-source project that lets AI agents reply with interactive interfaces like maps, charts and forms instead of plain text. It works with any model and supports React, Vue and other frameworks.

items.title: Genesys teams up with Sierra and Meta on a protocol for personal AI agents
items.summary: Genesys is partnering with Sierra and Meta on a protocol for personal AI agents, Telecom Reseller reports.

items.title: Self Labs ships Agent Vault so agents can pay and log in without real credentials
items.summary: Self Labs released Agent Vault, which gives AI agents stand-in tokens for logins and payments and swaps in the real credentials only at the moment of use. Users set spending caps, allowed merchants and a kill switch.

items.title: Manus makes a US$500M comeback push in China's agent market
items.summary: DigiTimes reports that Manus is returning to China's AI agent market alongside a US$500 million reset. See the source for the details.

items.title: Ledger adds Agent Intent: AI agents propose, your hardware wallet approves
items.summary: Ledger introduced Agent Intent at its Paris event: AI agents can propose actions such as payments, but each one has to be approved on the user's hardware wallet. Private keys stay with the user, and the beta is free on compatible devices.

items.title: Figma Specs feeds design decisions to coding agents over MCP (open beta)
items.summary: Figma Specs keeps written design decisions next to the frames and code they describe, and passes that context to coding agents over MCP. The open beta is rolling out now.

items.title: Rivian is bringing AI agents into its cars
items.summary: Rivian plans to put AI agents inside its vehicles, according to TechCrunch.

items.title: GSA hosts a government hackathon on MCP servers and AI agents
items.summary: The US General Services Administration has posted a government hackathon focused on Model Context Protocol servers and AI agents.

items.title: Figma sets rules for how AI agents work inside its platform
items.summary: TechCrunch reports that Figma announced new features defining how AI agents can work on its platform.

items.title: Attio launches a CRM built for humans and AI agents side by side
items.summary: Attio launched a CRM design where people and AI agents work from the same data, with SQL queries over up to 100 million records per object and permissions still enforced.

items.title: TasteSkill v2 gives coding agents art direction and a browser self-check
items.summary: TasteSkill v2 was rebuilt from scratch and gives coding agents an art direction, assets and a browser check so they can verify their own work.
